findings.detail: Aurora Energy Research identifier maturities 7/14/2032 and 9/3/2032 are not supported by the raw rows, which show 9/8/2032 for the matched facilities.
Steward Partners revolving loan identifier maturity 12/14/2028 should be 10/14/2028 per the raw schedule.
SupplyHouse revolving credit loan identifier maturity 7/1/2028 should be 7/1/2032 per the raw schedule.
The flagged Options IT terms match an Ohio Transmission delayed draw term loan maturing 12/19/2030, so the identifier has both issuer/row association and maturity defects.
Mitratech delayed draw term loan identifier maturity 12/22/2031 should be 12/2/2031 per the raw schedule.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The raw source rows for the flagged issuers and terms support the structured/XBRL maturity values, while the identifier-parsed dates are absent from the source or, for the Options IT item, attached to the wrong issuer/row. This grounds the flag as a real extraction/identifier construction error rather than a false alarm.
